name: The Rocks District of Milton-Freewater

known.article: The Rocks District of Milton-Freewater AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "The Rocks District of Milton-Freewater AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Warm days and cool nights keep acid and sugar in balance, and the long season lets tannins mature.

blurb.text: An Oregon AVA inside the Walla Walla Valley and the wider Columbia Valley, defined by its soil. About 96 percent of it lies on deep, cobbly Freewater series soils on an alluvial fan of the Walla Walla River, soils found only in tiny amounts elsewhere in the two larger AVAs.
